title: Changes in the chromatin accessibility landscape during human adenovirus infection.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Viral infections rewire the cellular environment, and this is often achieved through chromatin remodeling. Human adenovirus (HAdV) can directly modify specific cellular chromatin features; however, we still lack a global view of the changes in the cellular chromatin landscape induced during infection. To address how host chromatin accessibility changes during HAdV-C5 infection, we performed assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) in growth-arrested diploid human lung fibroblast (IMR-90) cells at 48 and 72 h post-infection. We detected widespread changes in chromatin accessibility, with 7,055 and 10,736 differentially accessible regions (DARs) on host chromatin at 48 and 72 h post-infection, respectively. At both time points, these changes mostly occurred in enhancer/intergenic regions and intronic regions. Furthermore, the pattern of changes in accessibility differed between protein-coding and non-coding genes. Integration of the ATAC-seq data with RNA-seq data demonstrated that significant changes in chromatin accessibility coincided with significant changes in gene expression during infection. Additionally, we found that increased DARs were enriched for forkhead and TEA domain transcription factor family motifs, while decreased DARs were enriched for motifs from zinc finger and basic leucine zipper domain families. Pathway enrichment analysis revealed that Wnt signaling pathway genes displayed increased chromatin accessibility during infection. Inhibition of the Wnt signaling pathway reduced viral gene expression and infectious viral progeny production, suggesting that this pathway is important for productive infection. Together, these data demonstrate that cellular chromatin is extensively remodeled during HAdV infection and expand our understanding of host-cell transcriptional regulation by human adenovirus. IMPORTANCE: Human adenovirus-C5 (HAdV-C5) infection extensively modifies the cellular transcriptome and proteome. However, other important aspects of the cellular environment, such as global changes in chromatin accessibility, have yet to be fully characterized during infection. Here, we performed assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) in infected growth-arrested diploid human lung fibroblast (IMR-90) cells at 48 and 72 h post-infection. We observed genome-wide changes in cellular chromatin accessibility and identified specific transcription factor motifs located in differentially accessible regions during infection. This work contributes another key piece to our understanding of how human adenovirus infection reprograms the host-cell environment and will inform future work directed toward specific chromatin modifications manipulated by HAdV that impact host-cell chromatin accessibility.

To address how host chromatin accessibility changes during HAdV-C5 infection, we performed assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) in growth-arrested diploid human lung fibroblast (IMR-90) cells at 48 and 72 h post-infection. We detected widespread changes in chromatin accessibility, with 7,055 and 10,736 differentially accessible regions (DARs) on host chromatin at 48 and 72 h post-infection, respectively. At both time points, these changes mostly occurred in enhancer/intergenic regions and intronic regions. Furthermore, the pattern of changes in accessibility differed between protein-coding and non-coding genes. Integration of the ATAC-seq data with RNA-seq data demonstrated that significant changes in chromatin accessibility coincided with significant changes in gene expression during infection. Additionally, we found that increased DARs were enriched for forkhead and TEA domain transcription factor family motifs, while decreased DARs were enriched for motifs from zinc finger and basic leucine zipper domain families. Pathway enrichment analysis revealed that Wnt signaling pathway genes displayed increased chromatin accessibility during infection. Inhibition of the Wnt signaling pathway reduced viral gene expression and infectious viral progeny production, suggesting that this pathway is important for productive infection. Together, these data demonstrate that cellular chromatin is extensively remodeled during HAdV infection and expand our understanding of host-cell transcriptional regulation by human adenovirus. IMPORTANCE: Human adenovirus-C5 (HAdV-C5) infection extensively modifies the cellular transcriptome and proteome. However, other important aspects of the cellular environment, such as global changes in chromatin accessibility, have yet to be fully characterized during infection. Here, we performed assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (ATAC-seq) in infected growth-arrested diploid human lung fibroblast (IMR-90) cells at 48 and 72 h post-infection. We observed genome-wide changes in cellular chromatin accessibility and identified specific transcription factor motifs located in differentially accessible regions during infection. This work contributes another key piece to our understanding of how human adenovirus infection reprograms the host-cell environment and will inform future work directed toward specific chromatin modifications manipulated by HAdV that impact host-cell chromatin accessibility.
title_original: Changes in the chromatin accessibility landscape during human adenovirus infection.

abstract_zh: 未标记:病毒感染会重新连接细胞环境,这通常是通过染色质重塑来实现的。人腺病毒(HAdV)可以直接修饰特定的细胞染色质特征;然而,我们仍然缺乏对感染过程中引起的细胞染色质景观变化的全面了解。为了解决 宿主 染色质可及性在 HAdV-C5 感染期间如何变化,我们在感染后 48 和 72 小时,使用测序 (ATAC-seq) 在生长停滞的二倍体人肺成纤维细胞 (IMR-90) 细胞中对转座酶可及染色质进行了测定。我们检测到染色质可及性发生广泛变化,感染后 48 小时和 72 小时,宿主 染色质上分别有 7,055 个和 10,736 个差异可及区域 (DAR)。在这两个时间点,这些变化主要发生在增强子/基因间区域和内含子区域。此外,蛋白质编码基因和非编码基因的可及性变化模式不同。ATAC-seq 数据与 RNA-seq 数据的整合表明,染色质可及性的显着变化与感染期间基因表达的显着变化相一致。此外,我们发现增加的 DAR 富集叉头和 TEA 结构域转录因子家族基序,而减少的 DAR 富集锌指和碱性亮氨酸拉链结构域家族的基序。通路富集分析显示,Wnt 信号通路基因在感染过程中表现出染色质可及性增加。抑制 Wnt 信号通路可减少病毒基因表达和感染性病毒后代的产生,表明该通路对于生产性感染很重要。总之,这些数据表明细胞染色质在 HAdV 感染期间被广泛重塑,并扩展了我们对 宿主 细胞转录调控的理解。重要性:人腺病毒-C5 (HAdV-C5) 感染会广泛修改细胞转录组和蛋白质组。然而,细胞环境的其他重要方面,例如染色质可及性的整体变化,在感染过程中尚未得到充分表征。在这里,我们在感染后 48 小时和 72 小时使用测序 (ATAC-seq) 对受感染的生长停滞的二倍体人肺成纤维细胞 (IMR-90) 细胞进行转座酶可及染色质分析。我们观察到 基因组 细胞染色质可及性的广泛变化,并确定了感染期间位于不同可及区域的特定转录因子基序。这项工作为我们理解 人腺病毒 感染如何重新编程 宿主 细胞环境提供了另一个关键部分,并将为未来针对 HAdV 操纵的影响 宿主 细胞染色质可及性的特定染色质修饰的工作提供信息。

title: Inhibitors of monocarboxylate transporters as host-directed antivirals against human adenoviruses.
abstract: Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are non-enveloped double-stranded DNA viruses that cause a wide range of typically mild, self-limiting infections in humans, but are associated with high morbidity and mortality in immunocompromised individuals. There are currently no approved antivirals specifically targeting HAdV infection. To identify novel anti-adenoviral compounds and host factors critical for infection, we screened a target-annotated library of 13,000 compounds, covering 1,763 known human targets, against HAdV type 11 in K562 cells. This screen yielded numerous anti-adenoviral compounds, many of which were kinase inhibitors, well known to also show antiviral activity. We instead focused on potent and selective inhibitors of monocarboxylate transporter 1 (MCT1) for further investigation. For 25 MCT1 inhibitors, antiviral activity correlated clearly with MCT1 inhibitory potency, indicating MCT1 inhibition as the likely mechanism. MCT1 exports lactate and is frequently overexpressed in cancers that rely on aerobic glycolysis; many viruses similarly reprogram host metabolism toward glycolysis, increasing intracellular lactate that must be effluxed. Unexpectedly, MCT1 inhibitors were ineffective in A549 cells due to compensatory activity of MCT4, as A549 cells express both MCT1 and MCT4, whereas K562 cells express only MCT1. A selective MCT4 inhibitor was inactive in both cell lines, suggesting that simultaneous inhibition of both transporters is required. Accordingly, combined MCT1 and MCT4 inhibition synergistically blocked HAdV infection in both transformed cell types and primary normal human bronchial epithelial cells. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在鉴定新型抗腺病毒化合物和对感染至关重要的 宿主 因子,解决 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 缺乏特异性 抗病毒药物 的问题,该因子会在免疫功能低下的个体中引起高发病率的广泛感染和 死亡率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在 K562 细胞中筛选了 13,000 种针对 HAdV 11 型的化合物,重点关注单羧酸转运蛋白 1 (MCT1) 抑制剂,因为它们具有阻断乳酸外流(HAdV 感染的关键步骤)的潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 在 K562 细胞中针对 11 型 HAdV 筛选了包含 13,000 种化合物的靶标注释库。MCT1 抑制剂已被鉴定并进一步研究其 抗病毒药物 活性和作用机制。
elements_zh.main_results: 筛选产生了多种抗腺病毒化合物,其中 MCT1 抑制剂显示出明显的 抗病毒药物 活性。MCT1 抑制与 抗病毒药物 活性相关,MCT1 和 MCT4 联合抑制可协同阻断转化细胞和原代正常人支气管上皮细胞中的 HAdV 感染。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,MCT1 抑制是 抗病毒药物 对抗 HAdV 的一种有前途的策略,强调了 宿主 细胞代谢在 HAdV 感染中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对 宿主 定向 抗病毒药物 靶向 MCT 的开发具有影响,该 宿主 可以有效对抗 HAdV 感染,特别是在免疫功能低下的个体中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到转化细胞系的使用以及需要在原代人类细胞和体内模型中进一步验证的限制。由于该研究的体外性质,证据强度中等。

title: A Confirmatory, Dual Center Nonhuman Primate Study on the Efficacy of Novel Oropharyngeal Spray Immunization With an Adenoviral Vector Vaccine Against RSV-Important Lessons Learned.
abstract: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Methods Rhesus macaques received an RSV fusion protein (F) DNA vaccine via electroporation, followed by two mucosal administrations of a recombinant adenovirus vector encoding the same antigen. Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. Conclusion Our results support the potential of mucosal adenoviral boosting following DNA priming to induce protective immunity against RSV, while highlighting challenges associated with multi-center preclinical vaccine studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in a dual-center, randomized, blinded trial involving rhesus macaques. The DNA vaccine was administered via electroporation, followed by mucosal adenoviral boosters encoding the RSV fusion protein (F). Control groups included mock-vaccinated animals and those mimicking natural immunity from primary RSV infection. The study observed robust immune responses but noted variability between centers. RSV-vaccinated animals showed reduced viral replication in the respiratory tract after challenge. However, unexpected immunity in the control group at one site hindered confirmation of the primary endpoint. The results suggest that mucosal adenoviral boosting may be effective for RSV vaccine development, but multi-center trials face challenges. These findings have implications for improving vaccine strategies and addressing limitations in preclinical research.

title_zh: 关于腺病毒 媒介 疫苗 对抗 RSV 的新型口咽喷雾免疫功效的验证性双中心非人灵长类动物研究 - 重要经验教训。
source_body_en: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. abstract_zh: 背景 在欧洲两个灵长类研究机构的一项随机、盲法、双中心研究中,我们评估了 DNA 初免口咽腺病毒加强 疫苗接种 策略针对呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 的免疫原性和保护功效。方法 恒河猴通过电穿孔接收 RSV 融合蛋白 (F) DNA 疫苗,然后两次粘膜施用编码相同抗原的重组腺病毒 媒介。模拟接种动物和模拟原发性 RSV 感染诱导的自然免疫的比较组作为对照。纵向监测全身和粘膜 免疫应答。结果我们检测到了强大的细胞和体液 免疫应答,但两个中心之间存在一些差异。然而,接种 RSV 疫苗的动物在 RSV 攻击感染后,上呼吸道和下呼吸道中的病毒复制明显减少。一个研究中心的对照组中出现了意外的 RSV 特异性免疫,导致无法确认预定义的主要终点。结论 我们的结果支持 DNA 引发后粘膜腺病毒增强诱导针对 RSV 的保护性免疫的潜力,同时强调了与多中心临床前 疫苗 研究相关的挑战。

analysis_zh.main_results: 结果我们检测到了强大的细胞和体液 免疫应答,但两个中心之间存在一些差异。然而,接种 RSV 疫苗的动物在 RSV 攻击感染后,上呼吸道和下呼吸道中的病毒复制明显减少。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论 我们的结果支持 DNA 引发后粘膜腺病毒增强诱导针对 RSV 的保护性免疫的潜力,同时强调了与多中心临床前 疫苗 研究相关的挑战。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们的研究结果表明,粘膜腺病毒加强可能是 RSV 疫苗 开发的可行策略,对改进免疫方案和解决多中心试验中的挑战具有影响。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 一个研究中心的对照组中出现了意外的 RSV 特异性免疫,导致无法确认预定义的主要终点。

title: Parallel transcriptomic and single-cell analyses characterize innate immune responses in human adenovirus infection
abstract: Abstract Background Human adenovirus (HAdV) can cause severe pediatric pneumonia, but peripheral blood does not directly represent the immune response in the lung. We examined independent blood and lung datasets to define shared directions and local cellular patterns. Methods Two public blood transcriptome datasets were analyzed alongside RNA-seq data from 13 children with HAdV infection and 10 non-infectious controls. Mouse lung scRNA-seq compared control, HAdV-3, and HAdV-7 groups, with three mice per group. Cell proportions and module scores used mice as biological replicates. CellChat was performed on group-pooled cells. Serum and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), lung IL-1β, and infected THP-1 cells provided independent validation. Results Public blood and pediatric PBMC data showed interferon, inflammatory, TNF-α/NF-κB, IL-6/JAK/STAT3, complement, and myeloid-associated programs. Mild ( n = 3) and severe ( n = 10) PBMC cases overlapped in PCA, and six immune signatures had adjusted P values of 1.00. The lung atlas contained 17 populations and localized antiviral and inflammatory programs mainly to myeloid cells. Several populations were unevenly distributed among mice. No mouse-level proportion or module-score comparison remained significant after correction; with n = 3 versus n = 3, the smallest possible two-sided exact P value was 0.10. CellChat nominated candidate myeloid-associated pathways without animal-level testing. In the same mice, 17 of 18 testable BALF analytes increased after HAdV-7 infection, whereas none of 29 testable serum analytes remained significant after correction. Conclusions Independent blood and lung datasets showed similar directions of innate immune change after HAdV infection. The contrasting BALF and serum results highlight the limits of peripheral measurements. The single-cell and CellChat results remain exploratory and require validation in larger, balanced cohorts.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 可引起重症小儿肺炎,但外周血并不能直接代表肺部的 免疫应答。我们检查了独立的血液和肺部数据集,以定义共享方向和局部细胞模式。方法 对两个公共血液转录组数据集以及 13 名 HAdV 感染儿童和 10 名非感染对照儿童的 RNA-seq 数据进行分析。小鼠肺 scRNA-seq 比较了对照组、HAdV-3 和 HAdV-7 组,每组三只小鼠。细胞比例和模块评分使用小鼠作为生物复制品。CellChat 在分组细胞上进行。血清和支气管肺泡灌洗液 (BALF)、肺 IL-1β 和感染的 THP-1 细胞提供了独立验证。结果 公共血液和儿科 PBMC 数据显示干扰素、炎症、TNF-α/NF-κB、IL-6/JAK/STAT3、补体和骨髓相关程序。轻度 ( n = 3) 和重度 ( n = 10) PBMC 病例在 PCA 中重叠,并且 6 个免疫特征调整后的 P 值为 1.00。肺图谱包含 17 个群体,局部 抗病毒药物 和炎症程序主要针对骨髓细胞。几个群体在小鼠之间分布不均匀。校正后,小鼠水平比例或模块分数比较不再显着;当 n = 3 与 n = 3 时,最小可能的双边精确 P 值为 0.10。CellChat 提名了候选骨髓相关通路,但未进行动物水平测试。在同一只小鼠中,HAdV-7 感染后,18 种可测试的 BALF 分析物中有 17 种增加,而 29 种可测试的血清分析物在校正后均不显着。结论 独立的血液和肺部数据集显示 HAdV 感染后先天免疫变化的相似方向。BALF 和血清结果的对比凸显了外周测量的局限性。单细胞和 CellChat 结果仍然是探索性的,需要在更大、平衡的 队列研究 中进行验证。

analysis_zh.methods: 比较对照组、HAdV-3 和 HAdV-7 组的小鼠肺 scRNA-seq 数据,每组三只小鼠。细胞比例和模块评分使用小鼠作为生物复制品。
analysis_zh.main_results: 公共血液和儿科 PBMC 数据显示干扰素、炎症、TNF-α/NF-κB、IL-6/JAK/STAT3、补体和骨髓相关程序。在同一只小鼠中,HAdV-7 感染后,18 种可测试的 BALF 分析物中有 17 种增加,而 29 种可测试的血清分析物在校正后均不显着。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 独立的血液和肺部数据集显示,HAdV 感染后先天免疫变化的方向相似。BALF 和血清结果的对比凸显了外周测量的局限性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,外周测量可能无法完全捕获 HAdV 感染中的 免疫应答,强调需要对肺部进行局部评估,以制定准确的 诊断 和 治疗 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 校正后,小鼠水平比例或模块分数比较不再显着;当 n = 3 与 n = 3 时,最小可能的双边精确 P 值为 0.10。单细胞和 CellChat 结果仍然是探索性的,需要在更大、平衡的 队列研究 中进行验证。

title: A broadly applicable strategy for adenovirus-mediated genetic engineering of CAR-negative mesenchymal stromal cells
abstract: Abstract Background Mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (MSCs) are promising cellular vehicles for regenerative medicine and cancer gene therapy because of their immunomodulatory properties, tumor tropism, and favorable safety profile. Adenoviral vectors are attractive for genetic engineering of MSCs because they enable high transgene expression without genomic integration. However, their application to MSCs is limited by poor transduction efficiency due to low or absent expression of the coxsackievirus and adenovirus receptor (CAR) in these cells. Although cationic reagents, including polybrene, have been reported to improve adenoviral gene transfer in some cell types, efficient transduction of CAR-negative mesenchymal cells remains challenging. Results We developed a polybrene-assisted spin infection protocol in which the combination of polybrene and centrifugation markedly enhanced adenoviral transduction across multiple CAR-negative mesenchymal cell types without increasing the viral dose. To determine whether improved transduction enhances therapeutic efficacy, mouse adipose tissue-derived stromal cells were transduced with an insulin-expressing adenoviral vector and transplanted into streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice. Cells transduced with polybrene-assisted spin infection significantly reduced blood glucose levels, whereas cells transduced without spin infection showed limited therapeutic efficacy. Conclusions Polybrene-assisted spin infection provides a simple and broadly applicable platform for adenovirus-mediated genetic engineering of MSCs and has the potential to enhance the therapeutic efficacy of engineered MSCs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决 CAR 阴性间充质基质细胞中高效腺病毒转导的挑战,由于其免疫调节特性和良好的安全性,这些细胞在再生医学和癌症基因治疗方面具有广阔的前景。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及开发聚凝胺辅助旋转感染方案,以增强 CAR 阴性间充质基质细胞中的腺病毒转导,使用表达胰岛素的腺病毒 媒介 转导小鼠脂肪组织来源的基质细胞,并将其移植到链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠中。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用聚凝胺辅助旋转感染方案,将聚凝胺与离心相结合,在不增加病毒剂量的情况下提高 CAR 阴性间充质细胞中的腺病毒转导效率。
elements_zh.main_results: 用聚凝胺辅助的自旋感染转导的细胞显着降低了血糖水平,而未经自旋感染转导的细胞显示出有限的治疗效果。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为证明聚凝胺辅助的自旋感染方案增强了 CAR 阴性间充质细胞中的腺病毒转导,为基因工程提供了一种新颖且广泛适用的策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,这种方法可以提高工程间充质基质细胞的治疗潜力,这可能对开发更有效的基因治疗方法具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于单一实验模型,这可能会限制普遍性,并且由于缺乏跨不同细胞类型或临床环境的更广泛验证,证据并不充分。

abstract_zh: 摘要背景 间充质基质/干细胞(MSC)因其免疫调节特性、肿瘤趋向性和良好的安全性而成为再生医学和癌症基因治疗的有前景的细胞载体。腺病毒 媒介 对于 MSC 的基因工程很有吸引力,因为它们无需基因组整合即可实现高转基因表达。然而,由于这些细胞中柯萨奇病毒和腺病毒受体(CAR)的表达低或不表达,它们在 MSC 中的应用受到转导效率差的限制。尽管据报道,包括聚凝胺在内的阳离子试剂可以改善某些细胞类型中的腺病毒基因转移,但 CAR 阴性间充质细胞的有效转导仍然具有挑战性。结果我们开发了一种聚凝胺辅助旋转感染方案,其中聚凝胺和离心的结合显着增强了跨多种 CAR 阴性间充质细胞类型的腺病毒转导,而无需增加病毒剂量。为了确定改进的转导是否可以增强治疗效果,用表达胰岛素的腺病毒 媒介 转导小鼠脂肪组织来源的基质细胞,并将其移植到链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠中。用聚凝胺辅助的自旋感染转导的细胞显着降低了血糖水平,而未经自旋感染转导的细胞显示出有限的治疗效果。结论 Polybrene辅助旋转感染为腺病毒介导的MSCs基因工程提供了一个简单且广泛适用的平台,并有可能提高工程化MSCs的治疗效果。

title: Monitoring of viral genome occurrence and persistence in municipal wastewater: a one-year study of adenovirus, polyomaviruses, and hepatitis A virus.
abstract: Monitoring viruses in wastewater can provide useful information on community-level viral circulation and the persistence of viral genome concentrations after treatment. The present study investigated the occurrence of four viral targets in 72 wastewater samples over a one-year period. The results showed that at least one viral target was detected in 55 of 72 samples (76.4%). HAdV was the most frequently detected virus (48.6%), followed by JCPyV (27.8%), BKPyV (22.2%), and HAV (16.7%). Detection frequencies were generally higher in influent than effluent wastewater for all targets. JCPyV showed the clearest treatment-stage difference, decreasing from 41.7% in influent samples to 13.9% in effluent samples, while HAdV detection decreased from 61.1% in influent to 36.1% in effluent samples. Viral load concentrations were higher in influent than effluent samples for all viral targets. HAdV had nine paired quantifiable influent-effluent observations, with a median treatment-associated reduction of 0.63 log 10 GC/L. Seasonal analysis showed the highest HAdV detection during winter (77.8%), while JCPyV was also most frequently detected in winter (38.9%); HAV detection was more sporadic and occurred mainly during winter and spring. Multi-virus detection occurred in 29.2%, most commonly involving HAdV with JCPyV or BKPyV. Infectivity assessment of 20 HAdV-positive samples showed cytopathic effect in 11 samples; 10 met the predefined combined criterion of CPE plus a ≥ 1-log 10 post-culture increase, with CPE-positive samples showing a median post-culture increase of 1.29 log 10 GC/L. The study supports the assessment of wastewater viral surveillance as a useful complementary tool for environmental virology and public health monitoring.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the occurrence and persistence of human adenoviruses in municipal wastewater to understand community-level viral circulation and the effectiveness of wastewater treatment processes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a one-year investigation of four viral targets in 72 wastewater samples collected from municipal wastewater systems.
analysis.methods: The study involved the collection and analysis of wastewater samples to detect viral genomes, with specific attention to the presence and concentration of human adenoviruses and their persistence after treatment.
analysis.main_results: At least one viral target was detected in 55 of 72 samples (76.4%), with HAdV being the most frequently detected virus (48.6%), followed by JCPyV (27.8%), BKPyV (22.2%), and HAV (16.7%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the potential of wastewater surveillance as a complementary tool for tracking viral circulation and assessing treatment efficacy, particularly for human adenoviruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of wastewater monitoring for public health surveillance, offering insights into viral persistence and seasonal trends in human adenovirus prevalence.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's generalizability may be limited due to the specific wastewater sources and the lack of detailed information on the infectivity of detected viruses, though the evidence is strong for the observed trends in viral detection and persistence.

analysis.summary_en: This one-year study monitored the occurrence and persistence of human adenoviruses in municipal wastewater, revealing that at least one viral target was detected in 76.4% of samples. HAdV was the most frequently detected virus, followed by JCPyV, BKPyV, and HAV. Detection frequencies were higher in influent than effluent samples, with HAdV showing a median treatment-associated reduction of 0.63 log10 GC/L. Seasonal analysis indicated higher HAdV detection during winter. The study supports wastewater surveillance as a useful tool for environmental virology and public health monitoring, though its generalizability may be limited. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the study and the absence of detailed infectivity assessments for all detected viruses.

abstract_zh: 监测废水中的病毒可以提供有关社区水平病毒循环以及 基因组 病毒 基因组 浓度在 治疗 后持续存在的有用信息。本研究调查了一年内 72 个废水样本中四种病毒目标的出现情况。结果显示,72 个样本中有 55 个(76.4%)检测到至少一种病毒靶标。HAdV 是最常检测到的病毒 (48.6%),其次是 JCPyV (27.8%)、BKPyV (22.2%) 和 HAV (16.7%)。对于所有目标,进水废水中的检测频率通常高于出水废水中的检测频率。JCPyV 显示出最明显的 治疗 阶段差异,从进水样品中的 41.7% 下降到出水样品中的 13.9%,而 HAdV 检测从进水样品中的 61.1% 下降到出水样品中的 36.1%。对于所有病毒目标,进水样品中的病毒载量浓度均高于出水样品中的病毒载量浓度。HAdV 有九对可量化的进水-出水观察结果,与 治疗 相关的中位减少量为 0.63 log 10 GC/L。季节分析显示,HAdV 在冬季检出率最高(77.8%),而 JCPyV 在冬季检出率也最高(38.9%);甲型肝炎病毒检出较为零星,主要发生在冬春季节。多种病毒检测发生率为 29.2%,最常见的是 HAdV 与 JCPyV 或 BKPyV。对 20 个 HAdV 阳性样本的感染性评估显示 11 个样本出现细胞病变效应;10 符合 CPE 加上 ≥ 1-log 10 培养后增加的预定义组合标准,CPE 阳性样本显示培养后中位增加为 1.29 log 10 GC/L。该研究支持对废水病毒 监测 的评估,将其作为环境病毒学和公共卫生监测的有用补充工具。

title: Epididymo-Orchitis Associated With Disseminated Adenovirus Infection in a Kidney Transplant Recipient.
abstract: Human adenovirus (HAdV) is a nonenveloped double-stranded DNA virus that causes self-limited illness in immunocompetent hosts but may produce severe, occasionally fatal disease in solid organ transplant recipients, with a clinical spectrum ranging from asymptomatic viremia to disseminated infection and allograft loss with increased morbidity and mortality. We present a rare case of disseminated HAdV infection diagnosed in a renal transplant recipient on maintenance immunosuppression, who presented with mild upper respiratory symptoms of coryza and subjective fever, followed by scrotal pain and swelling. Ultrasound showed bilateral epididymo-orchitis and diffuse scrotal edema. Urinalysis, cultures, and testing for chlamydia and gonorrhea were all negative. Adenovirus polymerase chain reaction (PCR) from blood and respiratory secretions was positive. In the absence of virological or histological confirmation, the association between HAdV and the scrotal findings is circumstantial; taken together with the temporal sequence and the exclusion of other bacterial and viral causes, however, HAdV is the most probable cause, and the patient was managed as probable disseminated HAdV disease. Immunosuppression was reduced without antiviral therapy; symptoms resolved gradually with recovery of allograft function, and repeat blood HAdV PCR at outpatient review 1 week after discharge was negative. To our knowledge, epididymo-orchitis has not previously been reported as a manifestation of HAdV disease in a kidney transplant recipient. Our case illustrates the extent of adenoviral disease after transplantation, the interpretive difficulty of attributing causation on the basis of molecular detection alone, and the adequacy of immunosuppression reduction as sole therapy in mild disease.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to highlight the potential for human adenovirus (HAdV) to cause severe disseminated infection in immunocompromised individuals, particularly kidney transplant recipients, where it can lead to complications such as epididymo-orchitis and allograft loss.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report describing a single renal transplant recipient on maintenance immunosuppression who developed disseminated HAdV infection, presenting with mild upper respiratory symptoms followed by scrotal pain and swelling.
analysis.methods: Adenovirus polymerase chain reaction (PCR) from blood and respiratory secretions was used to detect HAdV, and immunosuppression was reduced without antiviral therapy as the management approach.
analysis.main_results: Ultrasound revealed bilateral epididymo-orchitis and diffuse scrotal edema. Urinalysis, cultures, and testing for chlamydia and gonorrhea were all negative. Repeat blood HAdV PCR at outpatient review 1 week after discharge was negative.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the association between HAdV and the scrotal findings is circumstantial, but given the temporal sequence and exclusion of other bacterial and viral causes, HAdV is the most probable cause of the disseminated infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for vigilance in recognizing HAdV as a potential cause of severe disease in immunocompromised transplant recipients and highlight the importance of reducing immunosuppression in managing mild cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the absence of virological or histological confirmation, and the interpretation is based on molecular detection and clinical context, which may not definitively establish causation. The evidence is moderate due to the case report nature.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare instance of disseminated human adenovirus (HAdV) infection in a kidney transplant recipient, leading to epididymo-orchitis and scrotal swelling. The patient had mild upper respiratory symptoms initially, followed by scrotal pain and swelling. PCR testing confirmed HAdV presence, and symptoms resolved after reducing immunosuppression without antiviral therapy. The case highlights the potential severity of HAdV in immunocompromised individuals and the challenges of attributing causation based solely on molecular detection. It also underscores the effectiveness of immunosuppression reduction in managing mild HAdV disease. The study is limited by the lack of virological or histological confirmation, and the interpretation relies on clinical context and exclusion of other pathogens, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究旨在强调 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 在​​免疫功能低下的个体中引起严重播散性感染的可能性,特别是肾移植受者,它可能导致附睾睾丸炎和同种异体移植物丢失等并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是 病例报告 的研究,描述了一名接受维持免疫抑制的肾移植受者发生播散性 HAdV 感染,出现轻度上呼吸道症状,随后出现阴囊疼痛和肿胀。
elements_zh.methods: 使用来自血液和呼吸道分泌物的腺病毒聚合酶链反应(PCR)来检测HAdV,并且在不使用抗病毒药物治疗的情况下减少免疫抑制作为管理方法。
elements_zh.main_results: 超声检查显示双侧附睾睾丸炎和弥漫性阴囊水肿。尿液分析、培养以及衣原体和淋病检测均为阴性。出院后 1 周在门诊复查时重复血液 HAdV PCR 结果为阴性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,HAdV 与阴囊检查结果之间的关联是间接的,但考虑到时间顺序并排除其他细菌和病毒原因,HAdV 是播散性感染的最可能原因。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要保持警惕,认识到 HAdV 是免疫功能低下的移植受者患严重疾病的潜在原因,并强调在治疗轻症病例时减少免疫抑制的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因缺乏病毒学或组织学确认而受到限制,并且解释是基于分子检测和临床背景,这可能无法明确确定因果关系。由于 病例报告 的性质,证据是中等的。

abstract_zh: 人腺病毒 (HAdV) 是一种无包膜双链 DNA 病毒,可在免疫功能正常的 宿主 中引起自限性疾病,但可能在实体器官移植受者中产生严重的、偶尔致命的疾病,其临床谱包括无症状病毒血症、播散性感染和同种异体移植物丢失,发病率增加和 死亡率。我们报告了一个在维持免疫抑制的肾移植受者中诊断出的播散性 HAdV 感染的罕见病例,该患者出现轻微的鼻炎和主观发热等上呼吸道症状,随后出现阴囊疼痛和肿胀。超声检查显示双侧附睾睾丸炎和弥漫性阴囊水肿。尿液分析、培养以及衣原体和淋病检测均为阴性。血液和呼吸道分泌物的腺病毒聚合酶链反应(PCR)呈阳性。在缺乏病毒学或组织学证实的情况下,HAdV 与阴囊检查结果之间的关联是间接的;然而,结合时间顺序并排除其他细菌和病毒原因,HAdV 是最可能的原因,患者被视为可能播散性 HAdV 疾病。无需 抗病毒药物 治疗即可减轻免疫抑制;随着同种异体移植功能的恢复,症状逐渐缓解,出院后 1 周门诊复查时重复血液 HAdV PCR 呈阴性。据我们所知,附睾睾丸炎此前尚未被报道为肾移植受者中 HAdV 疾病的表现。我们的案例说明了移植后腺病毒疾病的严重程度、仅根据分子检测来解释因果关系的困难,以及减少免疫抑制作为轻度疾病的唯一疗法的充分性。

title: Adenoviral vectored porcine interferon omega-5 elicits strong antiviral activity and sterile immunity against foot-and-mouth disease in swine
abstract: Abstract Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a high economic consequence disease of cloven-hoofed animals, necessitating effective countermeasures for control. Outbreak prevention and control is supported mainly by inactivated vaccines; however, a 7-day period is required for the vaccine to confer protective immunity. In an effort to improve the protective window, biotherapeutic agents such as interferons (IFNs) have been explored for their potent antiviral functions against FMD virus (FMDV). In silico analysis of porcine IFN α1 and porcine IFN ω5 demonstrated distinct biochemical differences that could affect receptor binding and downstream signaling. In this study, we constructed and evaluated an adenovirus vector encoding porcine IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) as a novel biotherapeutic. In porcine cells, Ad5-pIFN ω5 induced antiviral IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) and demonstrates antiviral activity against FMDV. In vivo, 12 pigs divided into three different groups were inoculated with Ad5-pIFN ω5 (1 × 10 8 , 1 × 10 9 , and 1 × 10 10 pfu) and challenged alongside a control group with FMDV O1 Manisa 24 h post-inoculation. The highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected swine against challenge, suggesting sterile immunity, which is defined as no detection of viral replication in serum or nasal swabs and a lack of neutralizing antibody titers. Further analysis of innate immunity by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) revealed detectable induction of type I IFN in serum from animals receiving the highest dose, which correlated with protection. These findings demonstrate that pIFN ω5 is a potent type I IFN that can rapidly and effectively protect swine from FMD.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a high economic consequence disease of cloven-hoofed animals, necessitating effective countermeasures for control. The study aimed to explore novel biotherapeutic agents to improve the protective window against FMD.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated an adenovirus vector encoding porcine IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) as a novel biotherapeutic. In vivo, 12 pigs were divided into three different groups and inoculated with Ad5-pIFN ω5 at varying doses, then challenged with FMDV O1 Manisa 24 h post-inoculation alongside a control group.

analysis.main_results: In silico analysis of porcine IFN α1 and porcine IFN ω5 demonstrated distinct biochemical differences that could affect receptor binding and downstream signaling. The highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected swine against challenge, suggesting sterile immunity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that pIFN ω5 is a potent type I IFN that can rapidly and effectively protect swine from FMD. This study introduces Ad5-pIFN ω5 as a novel biotherapeutic with potential for application in FMD prevention.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide a foundation for developing rapid and effective biotherapeutic interventions against FMD, which could significantly improve outbreak prevention and control strategies in swine populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and the use of a single FMDV strain. The evidence is moderate, as the results are based on in vivo experiments with a limited number of animals and a single challenge virus.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of an adenovirus vector encoding porcine IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) as a novel biotherapeutic against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in swine. FMD is a significant economic threat to cloven-hoofed animals, and current vaccines require a 7-day period to confer protective immunity. The researchers explored biotherapeutic agents like interferons to shorten this protective window. In silico analysis revealed biochemical differences between porcine IFN α1 and ω5, which could influence their antiviral activity. In vivo experiments showed that the highest dose of Ad5-pIFN ω5 completely protected pigs against FMDV O1 Manisa challenge, indicating sterile immunity. The study also found that the highest dose induced detectable type I IFN in serum, correlating with protection. These results suggest that pIFN ω5 is a potent antiviral agent with potential for rapid FMD prevention. However, the study is limited by its small sample size and use of a single virus strain, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.main_results: 猪 IFN α1 和猪 IFN ω5 的计算机分析显示出明显的生化差异,可能影响受体结合和下游信号传导。最高剂量的 Ad5-pIFN ω5 完全保护猪免受攻击,表明无菌免疫。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,pIFN ω5 是一种有效的 I 型 IFN,可以快速有效地保护猪免受口蹄疫感染。本研究介绍了 Ad5-pIFN ω5 作为一种新型生物治疗药物,具有预防口蹄疫的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为开发针对FMD的快速有效的生物治疗干预措施奠定了基础,这可以显着改善猪群的暴发预防和控制策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和使用单一口蹄疫病毒毒株的限制。证据是温和的,因为结果是基于对有限数量的动物和单一攻击病毒进行的体内实验。

title_zh: 腺病毒载体猪干扰素 omega-5 在猪中引发强 抗病毒药物 活性和针对口蹄疫的无菌免疫力

abstract_zh: 摘要 口蹄疫(FMD)是偶蹄动物的一种高经济后果疾病,需要采取有效的防治措施。暴发防控主要由灭活的疫苗支持;然而,疫苗 需要 7 天的时间才能赋予保护性免疫力。为了改善保护窗口,干扰素 (IFN) 等生物治疗药物具有针对口蹄疫病毒 (FMDV) 的强大 抗病毒药物 功能。猪 IFN α1 和猪 IFN ω5 的计算机分析显示出明显的生化差异,可能影响受体结合和下游信号传导。在本研究中,我们构建并评估了编码猪 IFN ω5 (Ad5-pIFN ω5) 的腺病毒 媒介 作为一种新型生物治疗药物。在猪细胞中,Ad5-pIFN ω5 诱导 抗病毒药物 IFN 刺激基因 (ISG),并表现出 抗病毒药物 对抗 FMDV 的活性。在体内,分为三个不同组的 12 头猪接种了 Ad5-pIFN ω5(1 × 10 8 、1 × 10 9 和 1 × 10 10 pfu),并与对照组一起在接种后 24 小时用 FMDV O1 Manisa 进行攻击。最高剂量的 Ad5-pIFN ω5 完全保护猪免受攻击,表明无菌免疫,其定义为在血清或鼻拭子中未检测到病毒复制并且缺乏中和抗体滴度。通过酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 对先天免疫的进一步分析表明,接受最高剂量的动物血清中可检测到 I 型 IFN 的诱导,这与保护作用相关。这些研究结果表明,pIFN ω5 是一种有效的 I 型 IFN,可以快速有效地保护猪免受口蹄疫感染。

title: Respiratory pathogen spectrum, peripheral blood immunophenotype, and clinical characteristics of hospitalized children with Kawasaki disease complicated by acute respiratory tract infection: a retrospective cohort study
abstract: Objective To systematically delineate the respiratory microbiological landscape, peripheral immunophenotypic dynamics, and clinical trajectories in hospitalized children with Kawasaki disease (KD) complicated by acute respiratory tract infection (ARTI), and to evaluate accessible creatine kinase (CK)-normalized ratio models for early differential diagnosis. Methods This retrospective study analyzed a discovery cohort of 139 ARTI-complicated KD cases and 600 uncomplicated ARTI controls using targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) and flow cytometry. Novel CK-normalized ratio models were developed and evaluated in an independent validation cohort (156 KD and 203 controls). Results High respiratory pathogen co-detection was observed in hospitalized children across both cohorts (85.6% in KD vs. 85.3% in ARTI controls). Multivariate and specimen-stratified analyses revealed that human adenovirus (HAdV) was selectively enriched in the lower respiratory tract (BALF: adjusted OR = 3.321, 95% CI: 1.324–8.331, P = 0.011). KD patients exhibited marked peripheral lymphocyte depletion (ALC: 2.82 vs. 3.68 × 10 9 /L, P < 0.001), CD4 + T-cell reduction, and a proportional increase in CD19 + B cells (all P < 0.05). Leveraging paradoxical CK suppression during hyper-inflammation, CK-normalized ratio models consistently yielded higher numerical AUCs compared to solitary biomarkers; in the independent validation cohort, PCT/CK achieved AUCs of 0.870 (95% CI: 0.832–0.909) for total KD and 0.897 (95% CI: 0.860–0.935) for complete KD (cKD), while CRP/CK achieved an AUC of 0.835 (95% CI: 0.770–0.900, specificity = 90.64%) for incomplete KD (iKD). Clinically, KD patients had a lower overall respiratory complication rate (36.7% vs. 47.2%) but marked extrapulmonary burdens, including liver injury (19.4% vs. 3.7%), and coronary artery lesions (26.6%, with coronary artery aneurysms [Z ≥ 2.5] in 20.1%), resulting in longer stays and higher healthcare costs (all P < 0.05). Conclusion ARTI-complicated KD involves a distinct immunopathological process potentially associated with deep lower respiratory HAdV infection. The independently validated PCT/CK and CRP/CK models offer accessible, cost-effective adjunctive tools to assist in the in-hospital differential diagnosis of ARTI-complicated KD. Clinical management requires multidisciplinary balancing of intensive anti-inflammatory therapy with infection control.

title: First isolation and whole genome characterization of canine adenovirus type 2 from dogs in Vietnam
abstract: Canine adenovirus type 2 (CAV-2) is an important, globally distributed agent of the canine infectious respiratory disease complex (CIRDC). This study investigated CAV-2 in dogs in Vietnam, isolated a field strain, evaluated its replication in three cell lines, and performed whole-genome characterization. PCR targeting the E3 region detected CAV-2 in 17 of 70 (24.3%) clinical swabs from dogs with CIRDC-compatible signs. Partial E3 sequencing of three representative amplicons revealed co-circulation of vaccine-like strains (America–Europe lineage) and wild-type field strains (China–Turkey lineage). A representative field strain, CAV-2/Vietnam/H36/2023, was successfully isolated and serially propagated in MDCK, CRFK, and HeLa cells, producing characteristic cytopathic effects between 48- and 96-h post-inoculation. Illumina sequencing of the third MDCK passage yielded a 31,224-bp genome (50.2% G + C; mean read depth 71,204×), collinear with the reference strain CAV-2/Toronto/A26-61, with conserved gene order, transcriptional orientation, and splicing across all 29 coding sequences. The genome shared 98.84% nucleotide identity with CAV-2/Toronto/A26-61 and was most closely related to recent Chinese field strains. Comparative analysis within 29 coding sequences identified 301 nucleotide substitutions corresponding to 83 amino acid changes, including 82 substitutions and a single in-frame codon deletion (ΔP367) in the pre-terminal protein. Amino-acid substitutions were unevenly distributed and concentrated in the E3 and E4 transcription units and in the L4-22 kDa protein, whereas the major capsid proteins and the protein IX, pVI and Mu peptide precursors remained highly conserved. Phylogenetically, CAV-2/Vietnam/H36/2023 clustered within the China–Turkey lineage with recent Chinese genomes, and no recombination was detected. To our knowledge, this represents the first isolation and whole-genome characterization of a CAV-2 field strain from Vietnam. These findings emphasize the ongoing evolution and genetic diversification of CAV-2, providing a valuable reference for future molecular surveillance, pathogenesis studies, and vaccine efficacy evaluations.

source_records.abstract: Canine adenovirus type 2 (CAV-2) is an important, globally distributed agent of the canine infectious respiratory disease complex (CIRDC). This study investigated CAV-2 in dogs in Vietnam, isolated a field strain, evaluated its replication in three cell lines, and performed whole-genome characterization. PCR targeting the E3 region detected CAV-2 in 17 of 70 (24.3%) clinical swabs from dogs with CIRDC-compatible signs. Partial E3 sequencing of three representative amplicons revealed co-circulation of vaccine-like strains (America–Europe lineage) and wild-type field strains (China–Turkey lineage). A representative field strain, CAV-2/Vietnam/H36/2023, was successfully isolated and serially propagated in MDCK, CRFK, and HeLa cells, producing characteristic cytopathic effects between 48- and 96-h post-inoculation. Illumina sequencing of the third MDCK passage yielded a 31,224-bp genome (50.2% G + C; mean read depth 71,204×), collinear with the reference strain CAV-2/Toronto/A26-61, with conserved gene order, transcriptional orientation, and splicing across all 29 coding sequences. The genome shared 98.84% nucleotide identity with CAV-2/Toronto/A26-61 and was most closely related to recent Chinese field strains. Comparative analysis within 29 coding sequences identified 301 nucleotide substitutions corresponding to 83 amino acid changes, including 82 substitutions and a single in-frame codon deletion (ΔP367) in the pre-terminal protein. Amino-acid substitutions were unevenly distributed and concentrated in the E3 and E4 transcription units and in the L4-22 kDa protein, whereas the major capsid proteins and the protein IX, pVI and Mu peptide precursors remained highly conserved. Phylogenetically, CAV-2/Vietnam/H36/2023 clustered within the China–Turkey lineage with recent Chinese genomes, and no recombination was detected. To our knowledge, this represents the first isolation and whole-genome characterization of a CAV-2 field strain from Vietnam. These findings emphasize the ongoing evolution and genetic diversification of CAV-2, providing a valuable reference for future molecular surveillance, pathogenesis studies, and vaccine efficacy evaluations.

title: Temporal dynamics of respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients in Shanghai, 2019–2023: a multi-center longitudinal surveillance study
abstract: COVID-19 greatly reshaped the epidemiology of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), yet long-term shifts in multi-pathogen circulation remain poorly characterized.This study explored temporal patterns of common respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients before, during, and after the pandemic. A retrospective multi-center observational study was performed across seven sentinel hospitals in Shanghai, China (2019–2023). Hospitalized SARI patients aged ≥ 15 years were tested for 12 respiratory pathogens (22 subtypes) using real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). We stratified the study period into pre-pandemic (2019), pandemic (2020–2022), and post-pandemic (2023) phases for comparative analysis. In total, 4738 participants were enrolled. The overall pathogen detection rate decreased from 30.26% in the pre-pandemic period (2019) to 16.50% during the pandemic (2020–2022), then rebounded to 20.07% in the post-pandemic period (2023) ( P <0.001). A novel classification of four distinct temporal trends was established: (1) decline-resurgence for influenza virus (IFV), Mycoplasma pneumoniae ( M. pneumoniae ), Bordetella pertussis ( B. pertussis ), and human bocavirus (HBoV); (2) sustained decline for human parainfluenza virus (HPIV), human coronavirus (HCoV), human adenovirus (HAdV), human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV), and Legionella pneumophila ( L. pneumophila ); (3) transient peak for human metapneumovirus (HMPV); (4) continuous increase for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). IFV, HRV/EV, and HCoV consistently ranked top five across all periods. pneumoniae was the dominant pathogen (33.65%) in patients aged 15–44 years. Seasonal peaks of IFV and RSV were substantially reshaped in the post-pandemic period. The co-infection rate was 1.14% (54/4738), with IFV- M. pneumoniae was the most combination (20.37%). Respiratory pathogen circulation patterns changed substantially from 2019 to 2023. Persistent multi-pathogen surveillance is required to guard against single-pathogen outbreaks and concurrent multi-pathogen epidemics.

The study's large sample size and multi-center approach provide strong evidence, though its observational nature limits causal conclusions.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the temporal patterns of common respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients before, during, and after the pandemic, as the epidemiology of SARI was greatly reshaped by COVID-19, yet long-term shifts in multi-pathogen circulation remain poorly characterized.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective multi-center observational study was conducted across seven sentinel hospitals in Shanghai, China, from 2019 to 2023, enrolling a total of 4738 hospitalized SARI patients aged ≥ 15 years.
analysis_en.methods: Participants were tested for 12 respiratory pathogens (22 subtypes) using real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) to identify the presence of each pathogen.
analysis_en.main_results: The overall pathogen detection rate decreased from 30.26% in the pre-pandemic period (2019) to 16.50% during the pandemic (2020–2022), then rebounded to 20.07% in the post-pandemic period (2023) (P < 0.001).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors established a novel classification of four distinct temporal trends, including a sustained decline for human adenovirus (HAdV) among other pathogens.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for persistent multi-pathogen surveillance to monitor and respond to changes in respiratory pathogen circulation, including human adenovirus.

title_zh: 2019-2023年上海成人SARI患者呼吸道病原体时间动态:多中心纵向监测研究
source_body_en: COVID-19 greatly reshaped the epidemiology of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), yet long-term shifts in multi-pathogen circulation remain poorly characterized.This study explored temporal patterns of common respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients before, during, and after the pandemic. A retrospective multi-center observational study was performed across seven sentinel hospitals in Shanghai, China (2019–2023). Hospitalized SARI patients aged ≥ 15 years were tested for 12 respiratory pathogens (22 subtypes) using real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). We stratified the study period into pre-pandemic (2019), pandemic (2020–2022), and post-pandemic (2023) phases for comparative analysis. In total, 4738 participants were enrolled. The overall pathogen detection rate decreased from 30.26% in the pre-pandemic period (2019) to 16.50% during the pandemic (2020–2022), then rebounded to 20.07% in the post-pandemic period (2023) ( P <0.001). A novel classification of four distinct temporal trends was established: (1) decline-resurgence for influenza virus (IFV), Mycoplasma pneumoniae ( M. pneumoniae ), Bordetella pertussis ( B. pertussis ), and human bocavirus (HBoV); (2) sustained decline for human parainfluenza virus (HPIV), human coronavirus (HCoV), human adenovirus (HAdV), human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV), and Legionella pneumophila ( L. pneumophila ); (3) transient peak for human metapneumovirus (HMPV); (4) continuous increase for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). IFV, HRV/EV, and HCoV consistently ranked top five across all periods. pneumoniae was the dominant pathogen (33.65%) in patients aged 15–44 years. Seasonal peaks of IFV and RSV were substantially reshaped in the post-pandemic period. The co-infection rate was 1.14% (54/4738), with IFV- M. pneumoniae was the most combination (20.37%). Respiratory pathogen circulation patterns changed substantially from 2019 to 2023. Persistent multi-pathogen surveillance is required to guard against single-pathogen outbreaks and concurrent multi-pathogen epidemics.
abstract_zh: COVID-19 极大地重塑了严重急性呼吸道感染 (SARI) 的 流行病学,但多病原体循环的长期变化仍知之甚少。本研究探讨了成人 SARI 患者在大流行之前、期间和之后常见呼吸道病原体的时间模式。对中国上海七家哨点医院(2019-2023)进行了回顾性多中心观察研究。使用实时聚合酶链反应 (RT-PCR) 对年龄≥ 15 岁的住院 SARI 患者进行了 12 种呼吸道病原体(22 种亚型)检测。我们将研究时期分为大流行前(2019年)、大流行(2020-2022年)和大流行后(2023年)三个阶段进行比较分析。总共有 4738 名参与者参加。总体病原检出率从疫情前期(2019年)的30.26%下降至疫情期间(2020-2022年)的16.50%,随后反弹至疫情后期(2023年)的20.07%( P <0.001)。建立了四种不同时间趋势的新分类:(1)流感病毒(IFV)、肺炎支原体(M.pneumoniae)、百日咳博德特氏菌(B.pertussis)和人博卡病毒(HBoV)的下降-复苏;(2)人副流感病毒(HPIV)、人冠状病毒(HCoV)、人腺病毒(HAdV)、人鼻病毒/肠道病毒(HRV/EV)和嗜肺军团菌(L. pneumophila)持续下降;(3)人偏肺病毒(HMPV)瞬时峰;(4)呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)持续升高。IFV、HRV/EV 和 HCoV 在所有时期均排名前五。肺炎链球菌是15-44岁患者的主要病原体(33.65%)。IFV 和 RSV 的季节性峰值在大流行后时期大幅重塑。合并感染率为1.14%(54/4738),其中以IFV-肺炎支原体合并感染最多(20.37%)。从 2019 年到 2023 年,呼吸道病原体循环模式发生了很大变化。需要持续的多病原体 监测 来防范单一病原体 暴发 和并发的多病原体流行。

title: Risk of respiratory infections in closed communities: multi-dimensional risk assessment and integrated surveillance in a nursing home and a prison (Stell-ARI project)
abstract: Viral Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) are particularly relevant for people living in closed and vulnerable communities. The Stell-ARI Project aimed to design and apply a multi-dimensional framework integrating environmental risk assessment (based on building structure and management, resident population characteristics, indoor air quality (IAQ), and microbiological contamination of air and surfaces) with wastewater-based and clinical surveillance for SARS-CoV-2, Human Adenovirus (HAdV), Influenza Virus A (IVA) and B (IVB), Respiratory Syncytial Virus A (RSVA) and B (RSVB). This system was applied in two pilot institutional communities: a nursing home and a prison. The study design included questionnaire surveys of facility managers, residents and workers alongside environmental monitoring of chemical and microbial contaminants. Domain-specific and global risk scores were calculated. Scores were lower in the nursing home than in the prison for building structure and management (3 vs. 13) and resident population characteristics (3.4 vs. The chemical air risk score showed similar differences (1.3 vs. 3.0) and the two settings also differed in their indoor pollutant profiles. The microbiological air and surface risk score was also better in nursing home (4.0 vs 5.0). In both settings, a COVID-19 cluster was detected and SARS-CoV-2 and HAdV were found in air and surface samples, as well as in wastewater, not only in coincidence with clinical cases, but throughout the monitoring period, with a higher frequency in nursing home. In conclusion, this novel multi-dimensional structured approach, although needing further validation, represents a potential operational tool to support ARIs surveillance, prevention and control in closed and vulnerable institutional communities.

title_zh: 封闭社区呼吸道感染风险:疗养院和监狱的多维度风险评估和综合监测(Stell-ARI项目)
source_body_en: Viral Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) are particularly relevant for people living in closed and vulnerable communities. The Stell-ARI Project aimed to design and apply a multi-dimensional framework integrating environmental risk assessment (based on building structure and management, resident population characteristics, indoor air quality (IAQ), and microbiological contamination of air and surfaces) with wastewater-based and clinical surveillance for SARS-CoV-2, Human Adenovirus (HAdV), Influenza Virus A (IVA) and B (IVB), Respiratory Syncytial Virus A (RSVA) and B (RSVB). This system was applied in two pilot institutional communities: a nursing home and a prison. The study design included questionnaire surveys of facility managers, residents and workers alongside environmental monitoring of chemical and microbial contaminants. Domain-specific and global risk scores were calculated. Scores were lower in the nursing home than in the prison for building structure and management (3 vs. 13) and resident population characteristics (3.4 vs. The chemical air risk score showed similar differences (1.3 vs. 3.0) and the two settings also differed in their indoor pollutant profiles. The microbiological air and surface risk score was also better in nursing home (4.0 vs 5.0). In both settings, a COVID-19 cluster was detected and SARS-CoV-2 and HAdV were found in air and surface samples, as well as in wastewater, not only in coincidence with clinical cases, but throughout the monitoring period, with a higher frequency in nursing home. In conclusion, this novel multi-dimensional structured approach, although needing further validation, represents a potential operational tool to support ARIs surveillance, prevention and control in closed and vulnerable institutional communities.

title: Generation and Linear Epitope Mapping of a Monoclonal Antibody Against the Penton Base of Canine Adenovirus Type 2
abstract: Canine adenovirus type 2 (CAV-2) is an important respiratory pathogen of dogs and has also emerged as a promising non-human adenoviral vector for gene delivery. However, antibody reagents targeting the CAV-2 penton base remain poorly characterized compared with those directed against the hexon and fiber proteins. In this study, we generated and characterized a mouse monoclonal antibody (mAb), designated 3D5, against the CAV-2 penton base. Recombinant penton base protein expressed in Escherichia coli was used for mouse immunization and hybridoma screening. mAb 3D5 was identified as an IgG2b antibody with a kappa light chain and specifically recognized both recombinant penton base protein and viral antigen in CAV-2-infected MDCK cells by Western blotting and immunofluorescence assays. Sequential truncation mapping localized the antibody-binding region to the N terminus of the penton base, and a recombinant fragment spanning residues 29–36 (RYKGATEG) retained 3D5 reactivity under denaturing conditions. This sequence was identical in 31/33 CAV-2 and 4/4 CAV-1 accession records, and mAb 3D5 reacted with a recombinant CAV-1 preparation. MAb 3D5 showed no neutralizing activity. These results identify a N-terminal linear reactive region recognized by mAb 3D5 and provide a renewable monoclonal antibody reagent for CAV-2 antigen detection and further investigation of penton base antigenicity.
